name: coverage-check
title: Coverage check
description: Ask for a postcode and answer yes, not yet or check the address, with a notify-me field for the places you do not serve.
docs: Pass onCheck, which receives the trimmed text once it has passed the pattern and resolves with a result: a status (available, not-yet or unknown), an optional title and message, and optional details as label and value pairs such as delivery days or an install date. Every answer has a heading and its own icon, so the three differ without colour. The answer is a status message that takes focus, so a screen reader reads it, and Check another address brings focus back to the field with the old text selected. Pass onNotify and a not-yet answer offers an email field to be told when you arrive; it is called with the address and the text that was checked. label, placeholder and hint describe the field, and inputMode, pattern (a regular expression the whole text must match, a loose postcode shape by default) and autoComplete adapt it to postcodes, ZIP codes or full addresses; the two sentences that report a mistake name the field by its label, so an address field never talks about postcodes. action sits next to Check another address when the place is covered. defaultValue and defaultResult start the block on an answer. labels translates every fixed word.
